svg.title: Warden's Yard — Warden training wall
svg.desc: Training targets sit in separated pockets. A climbable wall and equipment carts support a full loop over the practice lane, outside enemy reach. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops
